title: Microsoft Teams: quick view controls in the chat list for GCC High and DoD (desktop, Mac and web)
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the roadmap, and Microsoft's release notes support the user display options. Independent searches confirm the undocumented default and tenant-control gaps; the only correction is to cite the second roadmap item discussed in the page.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls; changes
claims.claim: No tenant or policy control over these quick views is documented in an admin UI or automation reference.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams quick views chat list admin policy PowerShell Graph settings controls'; searched settings-policies-reference and Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy for quick view, chat list, followed and unread. No quick-view control found.

claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams quick views chat list admin policy PowerShell Graph settings controls'. Read both roadmap descriptions and the Government Channel feature entry; they describe user choices and state no administrator action or deadline.

claims.where: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Hiding or collapsing quick views removes the displayed mentions and followed-thread views from the top of the list.
claims.quote: These are views into mentions, followed threads, and more. This update allows users to choose when and how these quick views are shown. Users will have options such as always show, always hide, and show only when unread. Users will also be able to collapse the quick views section.
